# cachedir-tag

Folders marked as caches with a CACHEDIR.TAG file. The tool that made them recreates them.

**Name:** Tagged caches · **Category:** Build caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://bford.info/cachedir/>
